postal_system.full_code_rule: Treat a five-digit code as a La Poste routing assignment to one or more delivery localities, addresses, or special services. It is not an official polygon.
postal_system.commune_rule: La Poste code-to-INSEE-commune mappings and commune contours are separate evidence. A commune may have multiple codes and a code may serve multiple communes.
postal_system.cedex_rule: CEDEX and organization-specific codes are non-areal routing assignments unless independent public address and building geometry exists.
postal_system.model_geometry_rule: BAN-point Voronoi, buffers, alpha shapes, learned boundaries, commune unions, and AGID cell unions are derived candidate geometry only.
postal_system.territory_rule: Metropolitan FR stays separate from overseas ISO territories and Monaco even when an upstream La Poste table contains them.

exception_classes.rule: Retain every La Poste code-to-INSEE relation; do not collapse multiple communes to one centroid.
Use BAN address or official street/range evidence to distinguish codes inside one commune; a commune polygon alone is insufficient.
Keep CEDEX and organization routing non-areal unless independent address geometry exists.
Treat BP, CS, TSA, and poste restante as special distribution records, not surrounding building or postal area geometry.
Do not derive Corsican INSEE department identity from postal prefix 20; preserve COG codes 2A and 2B independently.
Route overseas territories and Monaco to their own ISO country packs and source-rights partitions.
Version commune mergers, delegated communes, postal changes, and address changes with separate valid and known times.

quality_gates.pass: Every source has a pinned release, digest, terms reference, attribution, geographic scope, and transformation method.
La Poste routing assignment, BAN address point, COG identity, administrative boundary, BD TOPO building relation, derived surface, and AGID index remain separate.
Postal code, house number, suffix, street, commune, BAN identifier, and BD TOPO relationship agree; conflicts remain alternatives.
All many-to-many code/commune relations remain queryable and no commune centroid selects an exact address.
Geometry is valid, bounded, versioned, clipped, and evaluated against independent holdout BAN addresses.
FR, overseas ISO territories, and MC are never silently merged into one country release.
No recipient, occupant, customer record, phone, delivery instruction, credential, or private unit assertion is published.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Source roles and legal blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned open snapshots reproduce experimental packs with full lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
